study type: Prospective cross-sectional study (Phase I) and prospective study (Phase II)
outcome: Correlation between fetal measurements and actual birth weight
cohort: 110 low-risk singleton pregnancies in Phase I (28-40 weeks gestation) and 91 patients admitted for elective cesarean section or induction of labor in Phase II (38-41 weeks gestation)
finding: Volume measurements of the fetus, particularly abdominal volume, may improve the accuracy of estimating fetal size compared to conventional 2D measurements.
